requires.why: A18: exercise the shipped host-settings reader, snapshot and author Setup warning with a synthetic TunnelVision manifest; no third-party writer or model is run.

''; return Boolean(row()) === visible && (!visible || (text.includes('scanning suppressed') === Boolean(book?.suppressesScan) && text.includes('Shared write access') === Boolean(book?.canWrite))); }; while (!matches() && Date.now() < until) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); if (!matches()) throw new Error('Setup visibility differs: ' + visible); }; try { st.getContext = () => { const ctx = original(); return { ...ctx, getExtensionManifest: (name) => name === 'third-party/TunnelVision' ? { display_name: 'TunnelVision' } : ctx.getExtensionManifest?.(name) }; }; root.tunnelvision = { enabledLorebooks: { 'SO-TV Lore': true, Other: true } }; root.disabledExtensions = (disabled ?? []), 'third-party/TunnelVision']; await refresh(false); root.disabledExtensions = disabled; root.tunnelvision.enabledLorebooks = { Other: true }; await refresh(false); return { checked: 8, models: 0 }; } finally { st.getContext = original; if (prior === undefined) delete root.tunnelvision; else root.tunnelvision = prior; root.disabledExtensions = disabled; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: author }); rt.notify(); }
